run_prep_feature_demo: run the script to extract text features from captions for demo dataset shards using SimCSE BERT
run_prep_feature_clipeval: run the script to build zero-shot text embeddings for CLIP-Eval dataset categories using SimCSE BERT
build_text_indfeatures: build normalized text embeddings from templates and labels using a pretrained BERT model and tokenizer
gather_caption_from_tarfile: gather captions from a tarfile shard and return them as a dictionary with caption and metadata keys
get_tarfile_path: get the path to a tarfile for a given shard ID from the dataset root directory
